How to Apply
These guidelines will help you navigate Illinois Tech’s application process.
Please note that each school—specifically Chicago-Kent College of Law and Institute of Design—and individual programs may have additional requirements to apply. Please connect with those colleges or program directors with any questions.
1. Gather Application Documents
Please note: All documents must be submitted in PDF format.
Official Transcripts
Scan a copy of your official and original paper transcripts, individual mark sheets, or electronic transcript provided to you from your institution’s registrar
Do NOT upload your institution's web-based academic record or a document stating it is not an official transcript (except for current Illinois Tech students)
If the degree is completed, you MUST upload your original degree certificate or provisional certificate along with your academic transcripts or mark sheets
Resume/CV
Submit a current resume that highlights your academic and professional experience
Personal Statement
Provide a well-written statement that outlines your academic and professional goals
Letters of Recommendation (May Be Required, Depending on Program/Department)
Requirements vary, but in most cases one letter is required for master’s programs and two are required for Ph.D. programs
Letters should be from individuals who can assess your academic and/or career achievements and potential (e.g., professors, employers)
Letters must be submitted through the online Application Portal; you will input the recommender’s name and email address, and they will receive an electronic invitation. Note that recommenders will type their recommendation directly into the portal, not upload a document.
GRE Testing
GRE testing is required for PhD. applicants. The GRE is optional for master's program applicants.
English Proficiency Requirement
International students must submit an English proficiency exam score. Get details here.
2. Submit Online Application
Complete your application via the Application Access portal. Provide all required information and documents before submission. Use the Application Access portal to monitor your status, and keep an eye on emails for updates.
Please be aware that updates will come via email (grad.admission@illinoistech.edu) regarding your application and its status.
3. Verify Document Submission
Log into the online portal to confirm that all documents have been uploaded and accepted.
If anything is missing, you’ll receive detailed email instructions.
4. Prep for Enrollment
If admitted, secure your enrollment and get ready to start your graduate journey at Illinois Tech!
To learn more about next steps, please visit our admitted students page.
